summary: Sujeet Kumar works in computational Indology and has held posts at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur and B.P. Mandal College of Engineering.

Suk Fun Ng is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Sinology who earned a PhD from the University of Hong Kong under Jing Yin and Yakupitiyage Karunadasa, having also studied under K. L. Dhammajoti. She became a professor at Hong Kong Baptist University.

Sukhen Ghosh works in Indology. He earned a master's degree from Visva-Bharati University (2019–2021) and a Ph.D. from Mahatma Gandhi Central University (2022), where he also served as a research scholar (SRF) in 2022.

Sukhlal Sanghvi (1880–1978) was an Indology and philosophy scholar. He studied at Shri Yashovijaya Jain Sanskrit Pathshala and under Balakrishna Mishra. He held posts at Gujarat Vidyapith, Banaras Hindu University as Chair of Jain Philosophy (1934–1944), and Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan.

Sukra Sagar Shrestha (1956–2018) worked in history, archaeology, and Indology. He served as an epigraphist at the Archaeological Survey of India (attested 1986) and the Department of Archaeology (attested 1987).

Sukumar Sen (1900–1992) was an Indologist and linguist who studied at the University of Calcutta under Suniti Kumar Chatterji and Irach Jehangir Sorabji Taraporewala. He served as lecturer and Khaira Professor at the University of Calcutta and secretary of the Linguistic Society of India.

Sukumari Bhattacharji (1921–2014) was an Indologist who studied at the University of Calcutta and completed a doctorate at Jadavpur University. She served as professor of English at Lady Brabourne College (1945) and taught at Jadavpur University from 1957 to 1986.

Sulagna Bhattacharya is an Indologist who completed doctoral studies under the supervision of Pratap Bandyopadhyay. Bhattacharya has held an H P Shastri Research Fellowship at The Asiatic Society (attested 2026).

Sulak Sivaraksa (born 1933) is a Buddhist and religious studies scholar educated at the University of Wales, Lampeter, and the Social Science Research Council. He held visiting professorships at Lampeter, UC Berkeley, Cornell, Toronto, and Harvard, and founded the International Network of Engaged Buddhists.

Suman Chakraborty works in computational Indology. Educated at Presidency University and the University of Calcutta, Chakraborty pursued Ph.D. studies at IUCAA, held a faculty post at the Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science, and was affiliated with IIT Kharagpur (attested 2023).

Sumathi Ramaswamy (born 1961) is an Indologist and historian. She studied at the University of Delhi, Jawaharlal Nehru University, and the University of Pennsylvania, and later held faculty appointments at the University of Pennsylvania and the University of Michigan.

Sumi Lee is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned an MA under Alexander L. Mayer at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and a PhD under Robert E. Buswell Jr. at the University of California, Los Angeles.

Sumit Guha is a scholar of history, archaeology, and Indology. He held a post at Brown University (attested 2003) and serves as professor emeritus at the University of Texas at Austin (attested 2026).

Sumitra Mangesh Katre (1906–1998) was an Indologist and linguist who earned his Ph.D. at SOAS under Ralph Lilley Turner. He founded Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute, holding its Indo-European Philology chair (1939–1971), and later became professor emeritus at UT Austin.

Sun-Ah Choi is a scholar of history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. Choi earned a PhD from the University of Chicago under doctoral supervisor Juhyung Rhi and studied under Richard Neer, Robert S. Nelson, Jaś Elsner, and Aden Kumler.

Sunanda Mukhopadhyay is a scholar in linguistics and Indology who conducted doctoral studies under Shyam Sundar Bhattacharya and has served as a research scholar/fellow at The Asiatic Society (attested 2026).

Sunayana Maiti is a scholar of history, archaeology, and Indology. She earned a Ph.D. from the University of Calcutta (2014–2021) and held appointments as a research fellow and scholar at The Asiatic Society.

Sung Yong Kang is a scholar in Indology and philosophy. Kang studied at Seoul National University and the University of Hamburg, and later held academic posts at the University of Vienna and Seoul National University.

Sung-Bae Park (born 1933) is a Buddhist and religious studies scholar who completed doctoral studies under Lewis Lancaster. He was an assistant professor at Dongguk University and later became Professor Emeritus at Stony Brook University.
Sung-Eun Kim is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies who earned a PhD at Seoul National University (2004–2012) and became an assistant professor at Dongguk University in 2020.
